versions.changelog:
liepin-hot-trend v0.1.0

- Released initial version to support Liepin job and company page summaries.
- Enables keyword/city-based job listing extraction and core detail structuring.
- Offers company info summaries (industry, scale, financing stage) from public pages.
- Forbids login, application automation, and bulk scraping; only public lightweight analysis allowed.
- Includes compliance tips and operation boundaries.
